readout_other: OCT angiography of vessel branch diameter; Evans blue extravasation; CD31 immunostaining
direction_notes: Neural activity was not measured; sonication produced persistent dilation of cortical vessel branches under 15 um (about 17% at 1 W/cm2, 27% at 10 W/cm2) and no significant change in larger vessels.
safety_notes: At 1.2 W/cm2, no gross tissue disruption or Evans blue leakage 24 h later; a 200 W/cm2 positive control produced tissue damage and extravasation.

target.label: the region overlying the forelimb’s representation on the primary somatosensory cortex

device.model: customized H-205B ring transducer; TPO-106 transducer drive system

timing.protocol_description: 20 s of 510 kHz ultrasound as 0.5 ms pulses at 1 kHz (50% duty cycle), delivered twice with a 10-minute separation, at 1 W/cm2 or 10 W/cm2 Isppa in separate animals.

source_quotes.n_subjects: We exposed four of these mice (the remaining animal was used as an unsonicated sham) to FUS within the intensity range used in these experiments (1.2 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) and, as a positive control for tissue damage, high intensity (200 W/cm<sup>2</sup>), at adjacent locations on the same cortical hemisphere (Fig. 5).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each animal was used in only one recording session.
